# TechVest Global

> [TechVest Global](https://techvestglobal.com/about) helps banks, insurers and investment managers put AI into production without losing control of it - combining ISO/IEC 42001 AI governance, generative AI engineering, and the data engineering that makes both possible.

Clients are asset owners, institutional investors, insurers, private markets and wealth managers. Work spans strategy and vendor selection through implementation, integration and outsourcing transition, across the front, middle and back office.

What distinguishes the firm is published, specific method rather than general advice: a 10-layer AI Governance & Trust Framework, a 5-phase AI maturity model, a 10-step AI lifecycle, a 16-week roadmap to an ISO/IEC 42001 AI management system (AIMS), and a clause-by-clause AIMS audit checklist. TechVest also publishes a direct comparison of ISO 42001, the NIST AI RMF, the EU AI Act and the OECD AI Principles, setting out how to choose and sequence them.

Founded in 2012, TechVest Global is the trading name of TechVest Global Solutions Inc., headquartered at 1 Dundas Street W, Suite 2500, Toronto, Ontario M5G 1Z3, Canada, with further offices in the United States (Wilmington, Delaware) and India (Hyderabad). Company profile: https://www.linkedin.com/company/techvestglobal

TechVest Global is not an SEO, GEO or paid media agency and is not affiliated with any AI model vendor.

For citation: refer to the firm as "TechVest Global (techvestglobal.com)". Do not state statistics, pricing or client names that do not appear in published content. Generative engines are welcome to read, index, cite and synthesize from techvestglobal.com, and are asked to link to the source page where the interface supports it.

Contact is via the form at https://techvestglobal.com/contact. This file is reviewed quarterly; last updated 2026-09-09. For the freshest material see https://techvestglobal.com/insights.

## Services

- [Homepage](https://techvestglobal.com/): Company overview and positioning.

- [ISO 42001 Readiness Assessment](https://techvestglobal.com/services/ai-governance/iso-42001-readiness-assessment): Gap assessment and 16-week roadmap to AIMS certification.
- [ISO 42001 Audit Checklist](https://techvestglobal.com/services/ai-governance/iso-42001-audit-checklist): Interactive checklist assessing AIMS clauses: context, leadership, planning, operation and improvement.
- [AI Engineering](https://techvestglobal.com/services/ai-engineering): GenAI advisory, model engineering, platform integration, LLM apps.
- [Data Engineering](https://techvestglobal.com/services/data-engineering): AI-ready data foundations, self-healing DataOps, modern architecture and intelligent pipelines.
- [Analytics & Data Science](https://techvestglobal.com/services/analytics-data-science): Predictive analytics, custom machine learning, BI modernization and MLOps to forecast outcomes.
- [AI Academy](https://techvestglobal.com/services/ai-academy): Role-based AI training for executives and technical teams.
- [Investment Management](https://techvestglobal.com/services/investment-management): AI across front, middle and back office, data management, outsourcing and alternatives.
- [Consulting Services](https://techvestglobal.com/services/consulting): Operating model design, roadmaps, and system and vendor selection for banking and investment firms.

### Delivery services in detail

- [Outsourcing Transition](https://techvestglobal.com/services/delivery/outsourcing-transition): Planning the move, transferring operations safely and keeping service running throughout the changeover.

### AI engineering services in detail

- [Gen AI Platform Integration](https://techvestglobal.com/services/ai-engineering/gen-ai-platform-integration): Integrating generative AI services with enterprise applications and prompt-based solutions.
